title: 小倉百人一首より (Selections from Ogura Hyakunin Isshu)
description: Six tanka (31-syllable classical poems) selected from the 小倉百人一首, the famous anthology of one hundred poems by one hundred poets compiled by 藤原定家 around 1235. These poems — about spring blossoms, snow on Mt. Fuji, autumn longing, and the sleepless nights of love — are memorised by Japanese schoolchildren and played as a card game (かるた) every New Year. Each poem is given with its hiragana reading to help N5 learners access the classical language.
author: Various (anthology compiled by 藤原定家, c. 1235)
license: Public Domain (青空文庫 — compiled c. 1235; all poets deceased)
